fields.statement: Change set 01M77VT6 (testscripts run inside a ship run write into ~/code/rhiza's main tree) serves no intent yet. The last run-repair bug fix (#484) served m4-runs-hold-up ('a run finishes without hand repair'), and the orchestrator had to move a stray file by hand here. Which intent should it serve? / How should the fix be shaped? Cause: workflows set GOTMPDIR={run_tmp} = <git common dir>/rhiza/runs/<id>/tmp, and go-internal testscript creates $WORK under $GOTMPDIR, so scripts that don't init their own repo reach ~/code/rhiza.
